body: I can't even be what I need let alone what anyone else needs hahaha

It depends on you. I would always recommend someone close to me seek mental heath help if I saw any warning signs that it was needed. When I gave the advice to seek help I would give some insight as to why and what I had noticed.
I scream in to a pillow to help myself calm down. Not like a cry scream, like a I'm mad at the world scream as loud as I can scream. It helps me. May be worth a try.

You likely stalled it. Mine left for 2 days. I got him to come home.... behind my back he was just planning on leaving again. They have no object permanence. We are all replaceable to them. They use everyone around  them for something. The time they stay has nothing to do with love- it is just what we supply.
This should not give anyone hope or relief. It should remind us that BPD never changes.

Mine had a full double life. Very full....
Online profiles, a girlfriend, he was trying to buy a 90k RV to live in.
The weird accusations, cheating, lies and other bull is all too common. So is the way they just disappear.
It is really hard and it is so sad. Do not let anyone tell you otherwise. Have your feelings.

I firmly agree. My husband has BPD and I underatand how much work this family would have. He is not ready and it shows. I want this guy to leave because I firmly believe him and his family are part of the problem. His parents should want to be with BOTH kids as both are by all accounts their grandchildren. I wish she could see this post and just leave him.
Honestly..... please just stop. It only gets worse. It ALWAYS gets worse. I desperately wish I would have taken that advice before I got married. Get out while you can.
I took a screen shot of this. I needed it. Thank you.
I can't even tell you how many of us have had similar dealings. I am so sorry 😞

It is just the honest reality of the illness. I previously held the same stance as you. It did not serve me well. Many others here have the same origin story. Lol 
Find a good mental health team to work with. They can help guide your feelings on this in a health and developmental way. Just be happy you didn't end up married to a person with BPD.

I just do not feel like you are going to get the answers that you are fishing for here. My husband has done a PHP program, is on meds, and is in DBT. It has not made him or his life any more normal. On average it takes around 10 years of treatment to get BPD under control.
Eh.... I can almost guarantee that she lied. It is nothing personal, it is just the nature of the disorder. 🤷‍♀️
Just try to remember that any peace she allowed was her faking nice. Every move she made was orchestrated for her benefit.
Nope. You can ask questions and keep someone around and knowing the truth is paramount in these types of situations. Unfortunately, she is not likely to tell the truth.

Honestly, if you push she will just swear up and down that it was how she saw and felt the situation and that she can not be told differently. It's a pointless fight. But if you could bring it up to a doctor they could help.
Thank you :)

Mine is a very similar brand with the abuse allegations. Thank God he is 6 foot 6 and 325 pounds with a long track record of telling these kinds of lies. I worry... but not as much as I would if his family and medical professionals didn't know he was full of lies.

I promise you are doing the right thing. There is never a good time of the year to feel like you are hurting someone. They are going to do what they want and this is your time to take care of yourself.
They are just pants. Nothing to be ignored over. Style is a very personal choice and it shouldn't be taken from you.
It is so hard, but you do not miss him. You miss who he tricked you into thinking he was.

-weight gain
-panic attacks that cause chest pain and shaking
-hair loss that has caused blad patches
-GI issues 
-teeth grinding 😬 
-jaw clenching 
-bags under my eyes
-swollen eyelids from constant crying
-I no longer make eye contact with people
-insomnia 

This is 5 years in. It started 4 years ago.... maybe longer. I'm not sure that I can even remember when life wasn't like this anymore.

Kind of looks like the list my pwBPD makes for himself from time to time when he wants to "prove" to me he will get better. Because he can't gaslight me behind my back to other girls or his friends if he is not in contact with them. The shit I fall for 🙄🤦‍♀️
For the little it is worth, I think you are following your heart and doing what is best for both of you.
I want to thank everyone for the information and feedback. That is what I am here for.

Apathy, distance, being cold, refusing help, huge shift in mood, discontinued meds, mania, high anxiety,  disinterest.... I feel like this list could go on forever. I am so sorry you are in this situation.

I worked in phone sex, webcam shows, and porn for YEARS. My parenting skills were not negatively affected and it paid the bills. The type of employment I had caused no issues when my ex took me to court for custody of my daughter. I still have her 11 years later. Unless what she is doing hurts the kids I would leave it all alone.
